title: Trump Cancels US-South Korea Joint Military Exercises, Citing Kim Relationship
detail: President Trump announced the cancellation of US-South Korea joint military exercises, explicitly citing his personal relationship with Kim Jong-un. The move represents a significant shift in alliance posture on the Korean Peninsula, echoing Trump's 2018–2019 suspension of exercises during the first round of US-DPRK diplomacy. South Korean officials and defense analysts warn the decision undermines combined readiness and could be read by Pyongyang as a unilateral concession without reciprocal denuclearization steps.

media.caption: Trump cancels US-South Korea joint military drills citing Kim Jong-un relationship
